x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
min_diff = 2e9
a_best = 0
b_best = 1
ratio = x / y

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a_candidate = int(ratio * i)
    diff1 = abs(a_candidate / i - ratio)
    diff2 = abs((a_candidate + 1) / i - ratio)
    if diff1 <= diff2 and diff1 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff1
        a_best = a_candidate
        b_best = i
    elif diff2 < diff1 and diff2 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff2
        a_best = a_candidate + 1
        b_best = i

print(f"{a_best}/{b_best}")
</translated_code>
